preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly three lines.
Line 1 contains 3 integers, line 2 contains 2 integers, and line 3 contains 1 integer, where parts1, parts2, parts3 are the split lines.
All six Hamming distance values are non-negative integers not exceeding 10^5.

preconditions.expression: any(x > 0 for x in [h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34])
preconditions.description: At least one of the given Hamming distances is positive.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (len(output_lines) == 5 and output_lines[0].isdigit() and all(len(s) == L for s in output_lines[1:5]) and all(c in 'ab' for s in output_lines[1:5] for c in s))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, the first line is an integer L (length), followed by 4 strings of length L containing only 'a' and 'b'.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (dist(s1, s2) == h12 and dist(s1, s3) == h13 and dist(s1, s4) == h14 and dist(s2, s3) == h23 and dist(s2, s4) == h24 and dist(s3, s4) == h34)
postconditions.description: If a solution is provided, the pairwise Hamming distances between the four output strings exactly match the input values.
If a solution is provided, the length L is the minimum possible length among all valid sets of four binary strings satisfying the distance constraints.
